text: この　わざを　みんなは　だいもんじやき　と　よんでるが　そりゃ　まちがいだ！

structure.jp: みんなは　だいもんじやき　と　よんでるが
そりゃ　まちがいだ！

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: だいもんじやき　と　よんでる
patterns.explanation: と comes right after the name that something is called. だいもんじやき と よんでる = 'they call it Daimonji-yaki'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a statement joins it to the next one with the meaning 'but'. よんでるが = 'they call it that, but'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows something people keep doing; in casual speech it shrinks to てる. よんでる = 'are calling' or 'call'.
